title: Cervical Spine MRI Analysis Report

case_header.title: Cervical Spine MRI Analysis Report
case_header.technique: Automated research-use post-processing of sagittal cervical spine MRI including segmentation, measurement, interpretation, and structured reporting.

clinical_report.technique: Automated analysis of sagittal cervical spine MRI. Research-use structured interpretation only; not a substitute for radiologist review.

findings_sections.heading: Alignment
findings_sections.body: Cervical alignment is straightened / low lordosis. C3-C7 Cobb angle measures -2.0 deg. Approximate classification only: derived from C3-C7 Cobb on supine MRI.

findings_sections.heading: Level-Specific Findings
findings_sections.body: At C5, functional canal / dural-sac AP minimum (SCT) 9.8 mm (stenosis_provisional); space available for the cord (canal AP - cord AP) 2.7 mm (high_risk); cord T2-hyperintensity screen (myelomalacia) 1.0 present (signal_anomaly_present).

findings_sections.heading: Cord / Syndrome Pattern
findings_sections.body: C5: pattern consistent with possible cervical myelopathy; clinical correlation required

table_rows.caveat: Measures SOFT-TISSUE dural-sac AP via SCT, NOT the osseous canal.
table_rows.citation: Nell 2019 (PMC6764695, C2-C7 healthy age/sex percentiles); stenosis bands >13/10-13/<10 mm are a clinical convention (Ulbrich 2014; Thelen 2019/SHIP) of OSSEOUS-canal / radiograph origin -- pending Phase-4 MRI soft-tissue confirmation

table_rows.citation: SAC <3 mm = high compression risk (plan-cited Fehlings 2015 / Nouri 2016) -- radiograph-origin, verify for MRI (pending Phase-4); Nell 2019 (PMC6764695) healthy percentiles

table_rows.citation: SCIseg (sct_deepseg lesion_sci_t2); Naga Karthik 2024 (PMC11065035). Measured healthy specificity 10/11 (~91%)

provenance.citation: Nell 2019 (PMC6764695, C2-C7 healthy age/sex percentiles); stenosis bands >13/10-13/<10 mm are a clinical convention (Ulbrich 2014; Thelen 2019/SHIP) of OSSEOUS-canal / radiograph origin -- pending Phase-4 MRI soft-tissue confirmation
provenance.caveat: Measures SOFT-TISSUE dural-sac AP via SCT, NOT the osseous canal -- do not conflate with bony CT/radiograph canal thresholds. Value is a stable across-slice minimum, not a single manual caliper point. Bands provisional (pending Phase-4). Finding for physician review.
provenance.provenance_note: Soft-tissue dural sac; bands provisional pending Phase-4 MRI confirmation.

provenance.display_name: space available for the cord (canal AP - cord AP)
provenance.citation: SAC <3 mm = high compression risk (plan-cited Fehlings 2015 / Nouri 2016) -- radiograph-origin, verify for MRI (pending Phase-4); Nell 2019 (PMC6764695) healthy percentiles
provenance.caveat: SAC <3 mm high-risk cutoff is radiograph-origin; verify for MRI. Derived from same-slice subtraction -> reliability depends on slice alignment. Stronger as a risk flag than a full severity ladder. Finding for physician review.
provenance.provenance_note: SAC<3 mm high-risk; radiograph-origin, verify (pending Phase-4).

provenance.citation: SCIseg (sct_deepseg lesion_sci_t2); Naga Karthik 2024 (PMC11065035). Measured healthy specificity 10/11 (~91%)
provenance.caveat: Cord T2-hyperintensity SCREEN (SCIseg): a positive level is a finding for physician review (pattern consistent with possible myelopathy), NOT a diagnosis; clinical correlation required. Binary present/absent; sensitivity rests on SCIseg's publication.
provenance.provenance_note: Group 5.1 binary screen; carried into Group 6 via the 5->6 flags contract.

provenance.citation: NASSJ 2025 (PMC12744292, asymptomatic C2-C7 ~18.7 deg, range ~10-35 deg); plan also cites Yukawa 2018 (~13.9 +/- 12.3 deg). Lordosis-positive.
provenance.caveat: Our Cobb is C3-C7 inferior-inferior and SUPINE (MRI reads ~5 deg less lordotic than standing radiographs) -> apply a supine->standing offset before comparing to standing norms; papers often report C2-C7. C6/C7 endpoint precision is not yet at target (SD ~16 deg; pending SPINEPS corpus + radiologist calibration) -> alignment is reported as a descriptive class for review, not hard-flagged.
provenance.provenance_note: Sign fixed (was -21 deg kyphotic); magnitude/endpoints pending SPINEPS + radiologist GT. The label side = lordosis_classification.
